summary_1line: Ravana rejects peace and asks Sarana to identify the monkey army’s leaders, who are then described along with their strength and roles.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands atop his snow‑white palace tower, gazing over mountains and sea at the endless monkey army covering the land around Lanka.
Angada, towering like a mountain peak, lashes his tail and faces Lanka while roaring a challenge before ranks of monkeys.
The monkey general Nila roars before Lanka with hundreds of thousands behind him, his voice shaking the city’s walls and gates.
